usage: Used for an acoustic guitar, as opposed to an electric guitar (電結他).
Common in music contexts, casual conversation, and instrument lists.
Can be used as a general noun with classifiers like 一支木結他 or 兩支木結他.
Natural in spoken Cantonese; learners often use it when talking about playing, buying, or learning guitar.
